text:
mike: Originating RC: rc-2026-03-21e (tag rc-e21). Artifacts pushed to registry:redwood/inference:rc-e21 and s3://ci/rc-e21/. Asking ops for artifact pin + KV warm. Proposed quiet window 02:00-03:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: [CI] RC created: rc-e21 (build 924). Artifacts uploaded. KV warm queued (job kv-924).

tara: Quick staging check done. No functional regressions. Noted slight increase in token count for a specific prompt family — added an eval case.

jyoti: From infra: please prefer NVLink racks for this RC, and set a soft-circuit at 1.5% error to avoid cascading retries. Prepared rollback snippet and a warm standby image.

```
# rollback to last stable
kubectl set image deployment/inference inference=redwood/inference:stable-2026-03-12 -n prod
# traffic revert (api)
curl -X POST "$DEPLOY_API/v0/traffic/revert" -d '{"target":"stable"}'
# deploy-bot rollback
deploy-bot rollback --rc rc-e21 --reason "auto-rollback"
```

ops-sheriff: I'm on-call for the quiet window and will be primary sheriff. Setting deadman switch to auto-cut at 2% errors or GPU OOM. I'll be at console 01:50 UTC.

deploy-bot: [kv-warm] started for rc-e21: warming ~700k prefixes, threads=5
[log] 50% complete...
[log] completed in 2m 5s, cache 820MB

mike: Canary plan: 0.2% for 10m -> 2% for 15m -> 20% for 20m -> 100% if green. Thresholds: p95 < 175ms, errors < 0.6%, token-cost delta < 6%. Observability runbook: https://telemetry.redwood/rc-e21-runbook (watch p95, p99, error-rate, token-cost, model memory).

tara: Release notes draft: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/rc-e21.md  added a short note about embedding token change and a migration snippet.

release-coordinator: Quiet window confirmed in calendar. Notifying enterprise customers who requested change windows. Marketing flagged a small blurb if full promote completes.

deploy-bot: [deploy] initiating canary: rc-e21 -> prod at 2026-03-22T02:00:10Z (0.2%)
[monitor] initial: p95=140ms, errors=0.04%, cpu=47%, gpu=39%

mike: Holding 10m. If green, step to 2%. Ops please watch autoscaler and eviction logs.

jyoti: No infra alarms. Proceed to 2%.

deploy-bot: [deploy] ramp to 2% complete at 2026-03-22T02:12:35Z. Monitoring active.

tara: Seeing a small uptick in token-cost (~2.5%) at 2% due to longer outputs on a subset. Within expected tolerance.

ops-sheriff: All green so far. Will trigger rollback if errors exceed 2% or if we see memory pressure.

mike: Proceed to 20% after 15m hold. If 20% hold looks good, we'll finalize and pin artifacts.

deploy-bot: [deploy] ramp to 20% at 2026-03-22T02:35:40Z.

release-coordinator: Sending short in-progress note to early adopters.

jyoti: No GPU OOMs, autoscale healthy. Ready for final promote.

mike: Promoting to 100% now and pinning: registry:redwood/inference:rc-e21, model:v2.4.4-rc1.

deploy-bot: [deploy] promote -> 100% at 2026-03-22T02:58:05Z
[deploy] final metrics: p95=148ms, errors=0.10%, token-cost uplift=3.4%, cpu=62%, gpu=50%

release-coordinator: Promotion done. Release notes updated and email queued. Will open postmortem if customers report regressions.

tara: Thanks team  locking rc-e21 as promoted. Closing thread. :tada:
